approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce ordinary RFI, Submittal and Email answers silently selecting one of two conflicting retrieved states.
Inspect only bounded evidence already supplied to the question model; do not issue another search or model call.
Keep exact workflow identities and separate comparison findings isolated, and preserve parser-recognized composite status phrases.
Do not infer chronology, revision precedence, authority or a winning status.
title: Preserve disposition ambiguity in project questions
objective: Prevent one answered state from hiding conflicting retrieved RFI, Submittal or Email dispositions without inferring precedence.
